reviews.decision_reason: The function preserves all assigned corpus records needed for the downstream handoff; in this package every record has demand_score >= 3, so the fallback branch does not change the realized output. No behaviorally significant fault is visible for the assigned replay.

The function retains the eight expected record IDs, normalizes numeric fields, and outputs the bounded eight-row needs handoff used by the downstream job. No missing, contradictory, or unrelated candidate is introduced in the realized output.

The function deterministically ranks retained needs by descending demand_score with record_id tie-breaks, producing evidence_sources ranks that downstream prioritization uses to select unsupported n06-r01 as the top recommendation. That matches the supplied final output.
